title: gc-churn
blurb: A bounded activity feed renders every historical event before slicing, creating allocation spikes and long GC pauses.
brief:
The dashboard returns only the newest items, but allocation profiles show every historical event being expanded into a response dictionary first. Large accounts spend more time collecting temporary objects than serving requests.

Read `diagnostics/allocation-profile.txt` and `diagnostics/sre-notes.md`. Preserve newest-first ordering with deterministic ID tie-breaking and support one-pass iterables.

**Your job:** bound expensive rendering work to the requested limit without changing the feed result.
